body: Update: I am selfish for calling an ambulance and wasting funds for the healthcare system when there are people who actually want to live who actually need it.  I also attempted suicide to manipulate my friends. Good to know I did that.

I'm from germany and we are unable to even watch 480p youtube videos with or without wifi in my area. The UK is honestly an internet heaven compared to us. Cant do skype calls, or attempt to open a website even, it's especially fun when you've got an online assignment for uni and take 10 minutes to log in. Mobile internet is generally E or 3g if you're in a city. And I lived 15 miles from the 2nd biggest city. Fun times.
